faqs.question: What is the VCX-1500 used for?
faqs.answer: It's a 1,500-watt production-scale ultrasonic processor for high-volume homogenization, dispersion, and emulsification across 10 to 50 liter volumes.

faqs.question: Can VCX-1500 run continuous processing, not just batch?
faqs.answer: Yes, the flow cell inline processing accessory converts it to continuous operation, or you can order the dedicated VCX-1500HV-220 configuration with the flow cell already included.

faqs.question: What cooling does VCX-1500 need?
faqs.answer: Compressed air cooling of the converter is required to prevent overheating during operation, not an optional accessory.

faqs.question: What electrical supply does VCX-1500 require?
faqs.answer: 220V, 50/60Hz, single phase, at 20A.

faqs.question: What's the difference between the three confirmed SKUs?
faqs.answer: VCX-1500-220 includes the converter, probe, and booster; VCX-1500A-220 includes the converter only; VCX-1500HV-220 includes the high volume flow cell configuration for continuous processing.

faqs.question: Can I use my own probe with VCX-1500?
faqs.answer: Yes, order the VCX-1500A-220 configuration, which ships with the converter but without a probe or booster.

faqs.question: What's the maximum probe amplitude?
faqs.answer: 100 micrometers on the standard 1" diameter, 10" long probe.

faqs.question: How do I confirm my facility is ready for installation?
faqs.answer: Confirm compressed air availability for converter cooling and a 220V single-phase, 20A electrical circuit before installation.

longForm.heroHook: From batch processing to continuous inline flow. Same 1500W processor, your choice.
longForm.heroLead: Production-scale sonication usually means picking your processing method before you buy the equipment. VCX-1500 keeps that choice open. A 1500-watt ultrasonic processor drives a 1" diameter, 10" long probe rated to 100μm maximum amplitude, with a booster included as standard for the extra displacement production volumes need. When your process calls for continuous rather than batch processing, the flow cell inline accessory turns the same platform into a continuous processing line, available as a dedicated pre-configured high-volume unit if that's your primary use case from day one. Running at this power level means real facility requirements: 220V single-phase power at 20A, and compressed air cooling of the converter, required, not optional, to prevent overheating during extended runs.

paragraphs: Three confirmed configurations cover the range from straightforward batch processing to fully continuous inline workflows. The standard VCX-1500-220 ships complete, converter, 1" probe, and booster, ready for batch-style processing out of the box. VCX-1500A-220 drops the probe and booster for labs supplying their own compatible hardware or building a custom setup. VCX-1500HV-220 goes the other direction entirely, shipping with the high volume flow cell pre-configured for labs whose process is continuous inline from the start rather than an added-later accessory.

Electrical supply matters just as much before installation. The system runs on 220V, 50/60Hz, single-phase power at 20A, worth confirming against your facility's available circuits before the unit arrives rather than after.

longForm.heroLead: Once your production volume crosses 10 liters, more power stops being a nice-to-have and starts being the deciding factor. VCX-2000 is built for exactly that threshold. A 2,000-watt processor drives a standard 38mm (1.5") probe with booster included, positioned as the better choice once volumes reach 10L and beyond. An optional 25mm probe brings genuine flexibility back down into the 1-10L range, so the same processor covers more ground than its production-scale positioning alone suggests. When continuous processing is the goal, the compatible 630-0705 flow cell with its 38mm flow-cell probe (630-0676) processes faster than the flow cell used with the VCX-1500, a real, direct advantage at this power tier. Electrical requirements match the rest of the production range: 220V, single-phase, 20A.

body: VCX-2000 flow cell: faster continuous processing than the VCX-1500, with a dedicated package configuration.

Three SKUs cover the practical configuration choices: complete with standard probe and booster, converter-only for custom builds, and a dedicated flow cell package for labs whose primary use case is continuous processing from the start.
